knownExclusions: This source is limited to DPOR Asbestos, Lead, and Home Inspectors board records and does not represent general contractor, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roofing, permit, or business-registration records.
The Board for Contractors asbestos specialty and supervisor-credential requirements may require checking the contractor-board source as well as this board source.
The lookup is not modeled as a confirmed bulk public dataset.

officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official bulk download has been confirmed in this phase.
researchNotes: Registry-only blocked source for now because the official path is lookup-oriented and no stable machine-readable public export contract has been confirmed.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Virginia DPOR asbestos, lead, and home inspector board records exposed by the official lookup.

verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while the official lookup contract and allowed reuse remain under review.

researchEvidence.note: DPOR states that the Board for Asbestos, Lead, and Home Inspectors licenses individuals engaged in asbestos remediation, lead-based paint remediation and renovation, and home inspection.
DPOR provides the public license lookup used for manual verification while no stable machine-readable source is confirmed.
Board for Contractors regulations identify asbestos contracting and related credential requirements, requiring caveats when checking only one DPOR board source.

blocker.summary: No stable, documented machine-readable official interface is currently suitable for an offline-tested adapter.
